sources.title: GitHub - SeoulDoriot/khmerOCR
sources.snippet: Khmer script text recognition: given a cropped image of one line of Khmer text, output the character sequence. Three deep learning approaches are trained on identical data, with identical seeds, and scored on one frozen five-domain test set, so the comparison measures the approaches rather than the experimental conditions.
